english.title: Fail to produce document to constable in respect of firearm in transit
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having the control or custody of

(A)_[a firearm,]_
(B)_[firearms,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE FIREARM / FIREARMS..), in the course of transit, failed on demand by **(..SPECIFY THE NAME..), a constable to produce

(C)_[a document,]_
(D)_[documents,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE DOCUMENT / DOCUMENTS..), in your possession relating to

(E)_[that firearm]_
(F)_[those firearms]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 49(3) of and Schedule 6 to the Firearms Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
having control of firearms in course of transit
failed, on demand by constable,
to produce possessed documents relating thereto

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) The court before which the offender is convicted may, if the offender is the owner of the firearm, make such order as to the forfeiture of the firearm as the court thinks fit.

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and / or for each firearm in respect of which the offence is committed, a fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale

Time Limit on Prosecution:
6 months
